intent: Bring code_tutor/_llm.py under the 250-line cap by moving the Anthropic-API backend into its own module, clearing the last code_tutor source violation.
scope: Non-goal: no assertion changed, no test deleted, skipped or weakened
changes: Moved ClaudeBackend into _claude_backend.py. The seam falls between the two backends precisely because each pins a different plain import: test_llm.py patches requests.post on _llm for OllamaBackend and anthropic.Anthropic for ClaudeBackend, so separating the classes separates the two pinned modules cleanly.
_llm.py keeps its anthropic import, because complete_with_fallback still catches anthropic.APIError, and imports ClaudeBackend back since it constructs one.

Repointed the four anthropic patch strings belonging to the ClaudeBackend tests. The two in complete_with_fallback tests stay on _llm, since that is the module whose globals the except clause resolves through.

verification.command: timeout 90 env PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m pytest python_pkg/code_tutor/tests -q
verification.evidence: 217 passed - unchanged from the count established by the previous commit.

verification.command: PYTHONPATH=. python3 -c "from python_pkg.code_tutor import _llm as l, _claude_backend as c; l.requests; l.anthropic; l.ClaudeBackend; l.OllamaBackend; c.anthropic; c.ClaudeBackend"
verification.evidence: resolve OK - anthropic is a real attribute of both modules, which is what makes the per-test split of its patch strings valid.
Only test modules are listed now: every code_tutor source file is under the 250-line cap.

verification.command: pre-commit run --files <the touched files and artifacts>
verification.evidence: ruff flagged E501 on a patch string the longer module name pushed past 88 columns; auto-formatted, then clean. pytest-with-coverage passes at 100%.

risks: anthropic is now imported by two modules and patched on both, for different reasons. A future change that stops complete_with_fallback catching APIError would make the _llm import unused, and ruff would strip it and break the two patches that remain there.
_llm imports ClaudeBackend from _claude_backend; the reverse import would be a cycle.
rollback: git revert the commit; _llm.py returns to 295 lines and _claude_backend.py disappears.
After rollback, re-run the package suite and confirm it still reports 217 passed.
